method.zh: 逐项核对原论文身份及论文、作者项目或官方实现中的明确游戏/环境记载。仅确认游戏归属，不验证能力测量、接口支持或运行结果。合集级确认不等于逐一核验所有子游戏；未公开游戏身份的记录保留待确认。
method.en: Check each paper identity and explicit game/environment evidence in papers, author projects or official implementations. This review establishes attribution only, not capability measurements, interface support or runtime results. Collection attribution does not verify every subgame; undisclosed identities remain unresolved.
